notes: Copula is placed on the predicate noun blessing under rule 20 rather than on the demonstrative subject.

the man of God: the article on the rectum takes the single written the, fronted to the phrase's left edge because the ASV renders God anarthrously (rule 29's fronting case); the construct keeps only man.
לִפְנֵי is retained as one fused unit headed on the construct noun (rules 23, 30); the ASV writes one English word for the pair.
